source: Bian et al. (2025), doi:10.1002/advs.202415732, equations 5 and 6
hne_unchanged: H and E coordinates, reference context ridge, additive head, person/class weights, train/validation/held-person folds
hne_network: Replace 36 correlation coordinates by 12 first-order conditional prediction-gain coordinates, separately for raw and context-adjusted states
null_expectation: psi((n-2)/2)-psi((n-3)/2), Gaussian zero-partial-correlation null; signed centered gain retained
native_input: Same 32-day state/context window available to DNB/FCM/CATCH
native_groups: Exact two-cluster one-dimensional k-means of past-window observed variances; higher-variance cluster is DG
native_missing: Keep channels with >=12 observations and positive variance; score undefined unless all selected DG-to-NDG edges are estimable
native_score: inverse mean first-order GC from DG to NDG; increasing risk direction fixed
native_adaptation: Groups use past data only, instead of the original iEEG onset-period variance. No claim of original seizure accuracy replication.
selection: Validation participant AUROC, falling back to negative log loss for single-class validation
decision: Complete both development cohorts and paired comparisons before any external extension
